name: Mechanical gear connection
summary: A gear-connection indication identifies transmission through a gearing relationship.
description: A gear-connection indication identifies transmission through a gearing relationship. A gear relationship transfers motion through the documented gearing arrangement. It can relate an operating member to a switch, position device or driven mechanism.
The schematic identifies the relationship while a mechanical drawing supplies ratio and geometry. Avoid treating the gear connection mark as a numerical reduction ratio.
readingNotes: State the driving/driven mechanism and any required ratio in the schedule.
The symbol does not give a gear ratio, tooth geometry or mechanical rating.
